access.notes: Open-source code for energy minimization and migration barrier calculations.

resources.name: Hart-Bates two-body potential parameters for LiCoO2

access.notes: Published in F. X. Hart and J. B. Bates, J. Appl. Phys. 83, 7560 (1998). The parameters (A, ρ, C) for Li-O, Co-O, O-O interactions must be extracted and converted into GULP format.

resources.name: LiCoO2 crystal structure (R-3m)

access.notes: Lattice parameters a=2.815 Å, c=14.05 Å, c/a=4.99, space group 166. The structure can be constructed from these known parameters or obtained from the ICSD.

resources.notes: The structure is widely available; the agent builds the unit cell using the given parameters.
